statement: No proper 13-coloring of J(24,12) is AGL(1,13)-equivariant (twist color(sigma A)=color(A)+1, color(tau A)=2*color(A)).
explanation: Each 12-subset is stabilized by the listed affine maps x->a*x+b on the 13-cycle {0..12} (fixing {13..23} pointwise). Equivariance forces color(S) = fixed point of c->a*c+b for each stabilizer (a,b) of S. Both A and B are forced to the SAME color, yet |A cap B| = 11 makes them adjacent: monochromatic edge. Hence the AGL ansatz admits no proper coloring.
